title: feat(cipher): Integrate CIPHER Zero-Trust Epistemic Sentinel
body:
This PR integrates CIPHER, a Tier 4 Sovereign Security Architect that operates as a physical node in the DAG to enforce zero-trust barriers (Anionic Rule Set) and prevent Semantic Saponification of security constraints.

- Implemented CipherSecurityNode in DAG Canvas.
- Extended types.ts with CIPHER_SECURITY_GATE and payload fields.
- Updated graphExecutor.ts with validateCipherTopology for mereological checks.
- Added cipher-zero-trust-sentinel prompt and cipher_ssr.jsonl MCP tools.
- Generated CIPHER_BLUEPRINT.md and CIPHER_EMERGENCE_PLAN documentation.
- Updated PRODUCT_STRATEGY.md and README.md with Epic 10 details.
